verdict: Leads fell sharply this week while spend nearly doubled — being addressed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 54 leads at a cost of $6.14 per lead, all through Meta. However, the most recent 7 days tell a different story: lead volume dropped 57% compared to the prior 7-day period while daily spend nearly doubled, pushing cost per lead up 22% and signaling the active campaign audience is fatiguing. At the same time, your Google Business Profile went dark on September 19–20, with actions falling to zero after averaging four per day earlier in the month, which is compounding the pressure on overall lead volume. Ad creative and campaign targeting are being reviewed this week to arrest the efficiency slide. Several infrastructure builds — including conversion tracking, landing pages, and search campaigns — remain in progress, and their completion will give us a much clearer picture of true lead performance going forward.

watch_item.issue: Spend nearly doubled while leads fell by more than half in the last 7 days, pointing to audience fatigue on the top campaign.
watch_item.fix: Campaign targeting and ad creative are being reviewed and refreshed this week to stabilize cost per lead.
